rows.note: Use 部分 for a smaller piece or component of a whole, rather than an essential principle or a contributing cause.

example.english: A small element of this painting was ruined by water.
example.traditional: 呢幅畫有一部分被水浸爛咗。
example.jyutping: ne1 fuk1 waa2 jau5 jat1 bou6 fan6 bei6 seoi2 zam3 laan6 zo2

rows.note: Use 要素 for an essential constituent or underlying principle, especially in an analytical description.

example.english: This report points out that trust is an important element of teamwork.
example.traditional: 呢份報告指出，信任係團隊合作嘅重要要素。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zi2 ceot1 seon3 jam6 hai6 tyun4 deoi2 hap6 zok3 ge3 zung6 jiu3 jiu3 sou3

rows.note: Use 因素 when the element is one condition or consideration contributing to an outcome.

example.english: The weather is one element affecting the trip arrangements.
example.traditional: 天氣係影響旅程安排嘅其中一個因素。
example.jyutping: tin1 hei3 hai6 jing2 hoeng2 leoi5 cing4 on1 paai4 ge3 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 jan1 sou3
